readme:
Use the GitHub MCP integration to securely connect to a GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and access GitHub tools in real time.

## What does this pack do?

This pack is intended for Cortex Agentic AI.

Connects to a GitHub MCP server to automatically discover tools and expose them as agentic system actions that users can enable for agents.

## Tools

Tool availability depends on the selected toolsets and server configuration.
The list below reflects the tools available at the time this pack was created and may change.
